newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore June industrial output down 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore June industrial output down 1.4 pct.

text.p: Singapore's total manufacturing output in June dropped by 1.4 percent compared to the same month of the previous year after growing 9.4 per cent in May, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement cumulative growth for manufacturing in the first six months of 1996 was 10.0 percent.
* Total manufacturing output excludes rubber processing.
A Reuter poll of economists earlier this month predicted industrial production had fallen by 2.2 percent year on year in June.
The electronics sector grew by 2.2 percent in June compared with a year earlier, but that growth compared to a 20.7 percent average expansion for the first five months of 1996.
The EDB statement said this was due to declines in the output of personal computers, consumer electronics, semiconductors and telecommunications equipment.
